rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the volume unit.

example.english: There is one gallon of water in this bucket.
example.traditional: 呢個水桶入面有一加侖水。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 seoi2 tung2 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 gaa1 leon4 seoi2

rows.note: Use this for a large quantity of liquid when “gallons” is not meant as a literal measurement.

example.english: The factory consumes gallon after gallon of water every day.
example.traditional: 工廠每日都消耗大量用水。
example.jyutping: gung1 cong2 mui5 jat6 dou1 siu1 hou3 daai6 loeng6 jung6 seoi2
